title: Percona: scale-out add (Galera SST join)
description: Runs `nexus scale-out add percona`: discovers a provisioned-but-unjoined PXC node (service stopped) and starts nexus-percona so it SST/IST-joins Galera and reaches Synced.

observe.what: <node> joined the Galera cluster via SST/IST (Synced)
cluster-size back to 3 on all nodes

whatProves: PerconaAdapter.ScaleOutAddAsync brings an unjoined node back into Galera via SST (apply-on-demand; exact is-active match avoids the substring trap).
